title: Serve organizations with delegated authority
description:
Outcome: organizations with delegated authority, not a single household tenant pretending to be multi-user.

Source: organizations-build-plan.html (phases 01–07, 24 items). Design reasoning belongs in docs/ORGANIZATIONS.md.

v1 waitlist: Google sign-in, pending organizations, members CLI as the only admin surface. Production marketing stays at chattic.us; app at hey.chattic.us / env hosts.

Not included: bot memory crossing channels, approval_fatigue as a scheduled item, a second organization computer, owner audit pipeline.
